balls.text: Cummins has his arms spread and a huge smile on his face, Hinge is smiling too. A plan has come together here. The ball was well outside off, back of a length. Jadeja went for a lofted hoick down to long leg, but Travis Head seems to have been placed there for this exact shot. Umpire checks the catch... and guess what, the ball has burst through his hands! At least that's what the umpire reckons... He's going through a few replays here, and adjudicates it "NOT OUT". Fingers were tucked under the ball, but the delivery burst through his fingers just enough and grazed the turf.

Tries to run down the wicket but looks around the ground, not sure where he's hit this one. Was followed down leg and Hinge rifled this into his pads, past his flick. Ran down to point, they pick up a leg-bye anyway
In the blockhole near the stumps, played out to long-on and Archer runs back for the second run

Another full toss goes unpunished. Was floated up on the stumps, there to be hit. But Hetmyer just couldn't get under this ball as he swivel-pulls this across the line. Straight to deep midwicket. Hinge finishing with a wicket next to his name, after the beating he took earlier this innings
Hetmyer runs down the pitch, outside leg. Bowler follows him and spears it in near his pads. Flicked towards deep midwicket

In the blockhole but Hetmyer runs this down to deep backward point! Modern batters can just hit you wherever they want, he opened the face of his bat and glided this late despite the ball landing near the wide marker
Begins this final over with a bouncer that flies wayyy over the head of Hetmyer, who runs down the pitch but never looked like he could reach this ball

Low full toss outside off. Jadeja gets hold of this one and flicks it in the air. Runs down to cow corner and Malinga's missed his length on the final ball of his spell. Still impeccable death overs job
Speared in on the stumps once more. Can only be flicked back to the bowler

Swiped across the line and right into Klaasen's hands down at long-on! He was way down leg, and got a low full toss too. There to be hit, but he mistimes this right into Klaasen's reliable bucket hands. Time to go back after a rather handy knock
This is turning out to be a great over. Right in the blockhole, flicked down to mid-wicket

Runs down the pitch for another hoick, but swishes at air once more. Ended up yorking himself by steppind down. Ball flies down to the keeper and SRH reckon there might a small edge. Review taken. Flat line as ball passes bat. Time to move on.
Yorker speared in on a leg-stump line, can only play it out back to the bowler
Quite full, right outside off. Drives it down to extra cover
Now he spears this in full. Ferreira looks for a big heave over cow corner once more, but mistimes an edge back into the pitch
And now he bowls too short. Sat up right below Ferreira's eyeline. He swipes this across the line and over deep square leg with disdain
Pace off and sits up outside off, back of a length. Batter rolls his wrists and swipes this down to deep square leg, had all the width he needed to hit this one away
Right in the blockhole, now. He tries to play it out down the ground, but bowler runs to his left to collect

In the slot and Ferreira dismisses this over long-on! Absolutely still head, and impeccable balance on his feet. Middles this one, and as soon as it came off his bat, you knew it would be sailing over the ropes
In the blockhole once more. Whaddabowler, Pat Cummins. Flick can only dribble down to mid-on
Another delivery right in the blockhole, flicked towards square leg and some excellent running gets them two
In the slot and now he hoicks this flick in the air. Deep midwicket runs in to collect this
Suffering from success! Was in the slot, right on the stumps. Ferreira bunts this straight down the ground, but too straight. Breaks the stumps at the other end
Sits up full outside off, driven down to covers

Cummins bowls a worldly of a yorker! The ball was speared in, and kept drifting in, drifting in, drifting in... Just sails past Parag's attempt at keeping it out, and pegs back his stumps... Cummins celebrates with both his arms spread. He enjoyed that
Another bouncer that just drifts past Ferreira. He tries to run it down late, but misses it completely
Bouncer rises from outside leg and angles away from the right-hander. He leans back and lets this one drift past him

Ferreira has smacked this deeep into the stands! Back of a length, rising up at his chest. He sets up deep in his crease and swipes at this like a baseball batter. Deposits this with a swipe across the line and over deep midwicket
On a length moving into the stumps. He drives it down to the covers once more

Almost a stunner flying in the air from NKR at mid-wicket! The ball was whipped from outside off, sitting up from a length. The ball stuck in one hand and then just flew out, nothing to do about that. Saves three runs
On a length just outside off. Punches this down to covers once more.
On a full-ish length outside off, driven straight to cover
Impeccably placed cut towards deep backward point! Was back of a length outside off, he opened the face of his bat and just ran it down to the vacant area
On a length, attacking the stumps, he drives it down to long-on
Good length outside off, driven down to deep extra cover
Back of a length outside off. Punches this drive off his back foot towards deep covers
Back of a length outside off, he glides this towards backward point and takes off anyway
And now Ferreira has bunted this down to deep cover! Was too full, outside off, and he just stands deep in his crease and resumes the carnage
Speared in short and travels way over his helmet, drifting down leg. Time to reload

And now a misadventure ends his innings. He grimaces, he knows he played the wrong shot here. Ball was speared in full, but he turned around in his crease to scoop this over deep fine leg. Could not get under the ball, and it's struck him on the pads. As plumb as it gets. He reviews. Might as well. But he's plumb, and his face reveals it too... And yes, impact in line, wickets hitting. He has to go back.

Sooryavanshi, this is the beginning of a legend in the making, but this innings has been as legendary as it gets anyway. He takes off his helmet and throws a salute at the dugout. The ball was full and right outside off. He simply stands in his crease and lofts this over long-on. Inevitable and yet awesome
He's really playing video game cricket here. Sat up in the slot, right on the stumps. He simply lofts this with those hugely powerful wrists of his, and gets it down to long-on
He's not lost his touch, has he! The ball sat up down leg side, erring in line. He simply flicks this slower 'un, 108.6 clicks, over deep square leg. Easy as you like
Back of a length outside off. Keeps low. Parag glides this late, towards point, and takes off for the other end
On a length and moving back into the stumps. Gets on top of the bounce and flicks him down to long--on
Full and speared in outside off, drives it down to the covers cordon first up

Extra cover runs in, and Aniket - who dropped Sooryavanshi earlier in the game - snares this one with ease! Sat up outside off and was there to be hit for Jurel, in all honesty. But gets a thick edge off his hoick looking to go downtown. Aniket had to just run in to complete a simple catch
On a length but drifting down leg once more. Umpire splays his hands
Full-ish outside off. Jurel plays a regal down to long-off. He pumps both his fists in the air and has a huge grin on his face. 34-ball fifty. He needs to finish off this innings with a big kick now
Back of a length and floating down leg. He goes for the pull but misses the ball. Too wide anyway
On a length attacking the stumps. Flicked down to mid-wicket
The outside edge trickles down to deep backward point. Was outside off on a length, moving away from the batter ever so slightly. Goes for an expansive drive and he won't mind that

Goes for another huge swing down the ground, but misses this all ends up. Ball's length was pulled back, floated up wide of off. Tempting him with a big hit and he goes for it, but misses the line of the ball completely. Lost his shape, for once
Toinked over cow corner and he's milking his hitting prowess tonight! The ball was right in the slot outside off. He just swung through the line and carted this over the ropes

Sooryavanshi's inspired by Jurel, and he says, what you can do I can do better! The ball was back of a length outside off. He reverses his stance and plays a reverse pull, down to deep square leg. He can do anything, can he...
Full and attacking leg stump. He gets on one knee and plays the conventional flick now, down to fine leg
Jurel reverses this down to deep backward point! He's getting a move on now. The ball was too full and drifting down off-stump. He gets down on one knee, switches up his grip, and middles this
On a length outside off, spun away from the right-hander. He crouches for a late cut, ends up missing the line of the delivery completely
Fuller but still well outside off. He drives this with great harrumph towards deep point
Aniket parries this over to the boundary! Back of a length and too much widhth outside off. He flicks this towards the vacant space beyond deep point, and a diving fielder can't save it.

Jurel's got this one out of the screws! Was in the slot, right on the stumps. He puts all his wrists into this cross-batted shot after walking across the stumps. Flicked over backward square. In fact, the ball has gone out of the stadium!
Short and welll outside off. Jurel climbs at this and bunts it towards deep extra cover
Full-ish just outside off, he glides this to backward point... His innings remains scratchy
Speared in on a length but drifting down leg, past Jurel's flick, and umpire asks him to reload
Full and on the pads, he reaches for this and flicks it to deep mid-wicket
Short ball angled across, tapped towards cover and a misfield means a potentially tight single is actually a simple one
Length ball angled across, he looks to pull it away but can only get it off the bottom half back to the bowler
Pace off, but Sooryavanshi picks it early! Too full outside off and Sooryavanshi crunches this wide of long-off!
Tucked through square leg for a single
Length ball angled across, can't nail the pull. Hits it along the ground through square leg
Full outside off, driven to cover's right. Good stop by the fielder
Straight as an arrow! Sakib overpitches outside and Sooryavanshi calmly lofts this down the ground. Nonchalantly done there. Sooryavanshi moves to 70 off 25!

Sakib puts down another return chance! Goes low to his left as Jurel hits it back at him. The ball is actually hit to his right so he sticks his right arm up to grab at it, but he isn't able to make it stick
Looks for a yorker on middle, Sooryavanshi eases it down towards long-on
Full outside off, driven to mid-off
Looks for the wide yorker. Misses his length by just a bit. Sooryavanshi looks to hammer this back down the ground but Hussain does well to stop it in his follow-through
Full outside off, driven down to long-on
Full around leg and Sooryavanshi misses with a hoick across the line. A fine three-run over from Cummins!
Steers this length ball down to deep third
Low full toss down leg, clipped to deep backward square's left
Length ball outside off, Jurel taps it towards midwicket and has to hurry for the single, with the fielder racing in and being quick to pick it up and have a shy at the non-striker's end
Back of length outside off, 139.5kph, Jurel is beaten on the outside edge as he tries to open the face to run it down fine on the off side
On a length just outside off, Jurel drops it in front as he plays a defensive shot
Full, wide and hit down the ground again! Fifty-stand up again as Sooryavanshi hits this straight of long-off running across
WHAM! Length ball outside off, and with a bit of width on offer, Sooryavanshi frees his hands and clobbers it over the sightscreen
Tries to take this away from his arc. Jurel cuts it out to deep point
Tossed up full and drifting away to pitch around off, Jurel blocks
Overpitched outside off and Jurel leans into a gorgeous cover drive. The ball races across the surface
Floated full on leg, Sooryavanshi eases it down to long-on. I am sure those are words I have rarely typed before!

Dropped by the bowler! This was a relatively simple caught-and-bowled chance and Sakib can't hold on. Jurel looks to drive this length ball back but gets it off high on the bat and pops to Sakib's left. He gets his hands down and behind the ball, but can't hold on
Nice change-up. Slower short ball around leg. Sooryavanshi had got in position early for a slog and waits on it and helps it square on the leg side

Half-century up in style! His third 15-ball fifty of the season! Back of length delivery angled across and he gets a hold of this one as he stands tall and heaves this over cow corner. And that's the first six off Sakib Hossain this season
On a length outside off, clipped square on the leg side for a quick run
Back of length delivery goes down leg for a wide
Low full toss outside off, as Hussain misses the yorker, Jurel meets it with an eye-catching drive past mid-on
Full on off, pushed out defensively to cover
Slower ball now, Sooryavanshi can only swing this to midwicket. This was a full toss on off, there to be hit, but the lack of pace probably put him off
The fielder stationed at deep backward square could only watch it sail just over him! This is 141.5kph, short and angled into him. Sooryavanshi swivels and nails the pull! He's raced to 44 off 13
Just clears the infield now. Malinga continues to impress. On a hard length on off and going across, Sooryavanshi looks to upper cut it but manages to just balloon it over point
Blocked towards mid-off
Short ball angled across, Sooryavanshi has a swipe and is beaten by the bounce

Sooryavanshi has been dropped at deep midwicket! Malinga's skiddy pace continues to trouble the Royals batters. This is a length ball angled across, and Sooryavanshi can't get enough on this pull. Aniket runs to his right at deep midwicket but makes a meal of the catch. And insult to injury, his foot touches the rope as he goes back to pick the ball up and throw it! He got under it, grabbing at it away from his body. The ball rolls off his palms onto his body and he can't adjust to stop that from dropping to the ground
Past the fielder! Jurel will feel better after that one. Length ball angled across, and he cuts it fine of the point fielder
Full on off and angled across, he manages to keep it out
On a length outside off, 140kph, dabbed to that fly slip fielder

Oh, the outside edge flies over the fly slip! Jurel, looking for a way out, skips down to this length ball outside off and has a swing. Gets a thick edge and he's lucky it's gone over Sakib Hussain there. He leapt with his arm outstretched but Jurel managed to get enough on that
Jurel jabs at this 141.4kph length ball outside off and chops it onto the ground

Oh, Cummins nearly had his man! 146.3kph length delivery around leg. Sooryavanshi looks to whip it away and gets it off the toe end. Hinge at deep backward square runs across but it bounces short of him and nearly spins away. But he stops it anyway
Sooryavanshi backs away to this length ball angled across him and waits on it before steering it fine on the off side. Can't get it past backward point, but almost had threaded the gap
Back of length outside off, it jags in. Jurel pulls it away along the ground to deep square leg
On al ength outside off, 140kph, Jurel gets inside the line to block
Oh, Jurel welcomed with a beaut! Cross-seam length ball outside off, draws Jurel into a defensive prod, and the ball seams away past the outside edge

Oh, Malinga strikes back! We saw Jaiswal almost get out the same way in the last over. Now Malinga does the trick. It's a 142kph back of length delivery around leg and angled across. Jaiswal is again hurried on the pull and this time the miscued pull sees the ball carry to Klaasen at mid-on
Malinga starts off with a gift to Jaiswal, who obliges with a boundary. Back of length, but it's outside leg and onto his pads. Jaiswal swivels and helps it along fine on the leg side

Deep midwicket never had a chance! Sooryavanshi hits his first ball off Cummins for six! This is short and angled across, Sooryavanshi waits on it and hammers a pull in front of square. The fielder could only watch it sail over
On a length around leg, Jaiswal tucks it through square leg
On a length on leg, blocked towards cover
The ball balloons up but doesn't carry to mid-on. Hard length on off and going across, rushes Jaiswal with this 142k delivery. Jaiswal scuffs the pull
Better length from Cummins now, at 139kph, Jaiswal punches to cover off the back foot
Cummins starts off by floating a half-volley outside off and Jaiswal caresses it through the gap at cover

Four! Four in a row! Sooryavanshi, if he held a grudge against Hinge for that dismissal in the last game, has already had a fair bit of revenge! This is also too full and Sooryavanshi lofts it down the ground. This was hit flat, but carries over the rope

And now on the other side. Hat-trick of sixes. This is right in the slot on middle and leg at 137kph, Sooryavanshi backs away a touch and lofts it down the ground as he meets it with the full face of the bat

Back-to-back sixes! This is on a length around leg and Jaiswal stays inside the line and flicks it fine on the leg side. The ball hangs high in the air for a long time, and eventually lands in the stands
Hoisted to the top tier! Sooryavanshi connected with this one alright! This is a 138kph back-of-length delivery and Sooryavanshi swivels on his feet and hooks him over backward square leg
Swing and a miss first ball! This is pitched fuller and slanted across him. Sooryavanshi wants to swing this over long-on but can't connect. Beaten on the outside edge
Hinge starts off with a 138kph ball on a hard length and angled across him. Jaiswal cuts it away to deep backward point

What a way to finish off the chase! Too full and on the pads. Salil whips his bat around to flick this over deep square leg. Great wrists on this one. Four wins in a row for SRH, and they are solidifying their spot in the top four...
Back of a length outside off, Aniket just sticks out his bat and plays a laaaate glide down to deep third
Speared in down leg. That won't help RR's cause. On a length but drifting too far, umpire splays his hands
Back of a length outside off, moves in towards the stumps. Salil knows a drive down to point is enough at this point

Klaasen has pulled this juice full toss, on his hips, right to Bishnoi at deep square leg! Was there to be deposited over the ropes, but ball died on Klaasen just a little bit. Klaasen asks if it's a waist-height no ball, and the umpires oblige with a check. Ball below his waist, Klaasen has to walk back in the end

Outside off on a length. Klaasen lets this one go, and it's so well outside off that umpire calls it a wide. But Brijesh reckons it might be inside the wide marker... RR have gone for the review... And whaddyaknow? Third ump reckons there's something of the ball inside the wide-line graphic. Extra overturned
Low full toss on the off stump. Driven straight to covers
Slower 'un, a yorker right in the blockhole. Played out to long-on

What a brilliant yorker, this one! Absolutely spears this one in, in front of the stumps, throwing NKR nearly off his feet. But he recovers. And also reviews instantly. Reckons there might be an edge to save him? Ball tracking turns up three reds. NKR has to make the long walk back home before he can finish this off. As good as finished this chase off, though
NKR in a hurry to get this done with. A nothingburger of a short ball, dies in its bounce and ends up only near the hips. Pulled over deep square leg
Slower 'un ends up as a low full toss on Klaasen's pads, and he flicks this between cow corner and deep midwicket. Picked the gap perfectly there
In the blockhole once more now. Attacking the pads. Somehow still manages to drive this towards covers. Batters are just so good with playing out yorkers with a low-risk shot, and scoring anyway...
Sits up to be hit and Reddy obliges! Was a short ball but completely lost its pace after bouncing. Sat up in front of NKR and he just pulled this across the line, over deep midwicket
Full outside off, flicked towards long-on
Now right in the blockhole, but Klaasen stays back to play this from in front of the stumps and down to long-off. Quick on that drive
Deshpande lands this right in the slot, outside off. Klaasen, run a ball so far, plays a classy lofted drive over long-off
Speared into the blockhole on the pads down leg once more. Flicked to cow corner
Fuller length down the leg, Klaasen flicks this towards long-on
On a length and angling in towards the stumps. Driven right back at the bowler. Held its shape beautifully
Another low full toss outside off. Driven to extra cover... Was there to be hit!
Another one right in the blockhole, a little slow through the air now. Driven down to long-off
Spears in a yorker first up, a very low full toss right on the stumps it turns out to be. Driven down to long-on
What a cracking shot to end this mini-battle. The ball was right in the slot, outside off, 148 kph. But Reddy holds the pose and drives this down to long-off with a high elbow, holds the pose
Rears up at the batter once more... Back of a length and takes the top edge off the batter's attempted flick. Runs down to extra cover
Bouncer aimed right at Klaasen. He almost ducks out of the way as he reaches for it, from in front of his eyes, and bunts this down to long-on
On a length but rising at his chest because of the extra bounce. Flicked down to deep midwicket
Back of a length outside off. Driven down to deep extra cover

Brijesh adds another one to a huuuge drop tally... Archer rushed NKR once more, bouncing this right into his helmet. Top edge off a rash hoick, down to deep third, where Brijesh runs in and drops another catch. Ball just burst out of his hands
On a length outside off. Klaasen checks this drive at the last moment to take power off it, and have it land in front of cover instead of in his hands
On a length and angled away from the batter. Driven down to covers
Rising at NKR but again he just plays a late cut to glide it down to deep backward point! Good pace on the ball but the line gives up too much width, and the batter's been pouncing on those so far
On a full length outside off, NKR creams this drive down to deep extra cover. Ravi Singh runs in from deep cover, slides and collects. Great fielding
On a length and outside off. Reddy pushes the ball down to mid-off with a drive, but can't get it past the fielder
Back of a length and rising at his chest. NKR hoicks this one across the line, over the ropes at long leg. Bishnoi signals a six down there
Back of a length and now Klaasen brings out the lawn-mower. Rose right at Klaasen's bat handle, he took a hand off on impact
Back of a length and rising wayyy past Klaasen's bunt.. The ball rose so high from a good length and rushed past Klaasen's bat

Archer has rushed him with a nasty bouncer there! Almost runs away off the top edge down to long stop, but fielder runs in from the left to cut off the boundary. The ball rose right at Reddy's head there, and he went for a hoick but took his eyes off the ball
Back of a length outside off, tucked down to covers
On a length outside off, a precarious defense down the pitch

Ferreira pulls out a stunner down at long-off to absolve the sins of RR's fielders! Somewhat... The ball was banged in on a hard length. Kishan whipped this one with a lofted bat, but mistimed this as one hand came off the bat handle. Ferreira lept in the air and rolled on the turf in his follow-through
On a length outside off, but now too close to the batter's hitting range. Klaasen sits dip in the crease and boinks this drive down to the vacant long-off boundary
On as length but speared in far too down the off side. Time to reload
A little too much width outside off. Jumps up from a length and cut towards deep point
On a length outside off. Cracks this drive straight to covers

Bishnoi now lets one slip through his hands... The ball was speared in outside off, spinning back in. Kishan crouched and cut this straight to backward point, where Bishnoi makes a meal of that easy save
Back of a length and kept outside off, driven to deep extra cover
Follows the batter down leg. Tucks this drive off a good length delivery, down to the covers once more
The bowler has to dive and still can't stop it, because how powerfully this was struck. Bishnoi goes for a long hop, it spins away outside off. Smashed across the line and down to long-on
And now Kishan says thank you very much! The ball was on an okay length down leg, but Kishan got down on one knee and just hoicked this over deep midwicket
Full-ish and spinning back in, driven down to covers once more
Back of a length and kept outside off. Cut to covers now`
Huuuuge loft and over the deep extra cover boundary! Was sitting up in the slot outside off. Pounced on the width
On a length and at the pads, flicked down to deep square leg

On a day where catches are going down for fun, Archer holds on to a really good one! Ferreira gets the breakthrough with a full ball cramping Abhishek for room. he backs away and looks to go down the ground. Gets a lot of height, but it's just a bit short of the boundary. Archer grabs it well above head height and does well to keep his balance
On a length outside off, tucked down to long-on
Tonked over long-on! Kishan uses his feet well to get to the pitch of the ball and swings for the hills. 87-metre six is the result
24-ball fifty for Ishan Kishan! Just a tad short and he rocks back and pulls it away through square leg
Full outside leg now, again, Abhishek makes room and drills it out to long-off for a single
Tossed up full on leg, Abhishek drives it out to long-off and they get two
Another full toss angled across him, Kishan steers it fine on the off side. Deep point has to race to his right and Kishan picks up two more to move to 49
Full outside off, he thrashes a drive to deep point
Full but slides down leg
Length ball outside off, punched to cover

Brings up a lovely fifty, after struggling at the start. Full toss outside off and he opens the blade to steer it through the vacant point region. Fifty off just 24 balls (although that feels slow today!)
Oh, that's four more. Slower short ball on leg, pulled away through square leg. Bisects the fielders in the deep perfectly
Full outside off, drilled to long-off
Full toss flung across him, Kishan slices it out to deep third
Beats the fielder! On a length outside off, Kishan leans across and flays it through cover. The off-side sweeper was running to his left but Hetmyer can't get it
Full outside off, drilled to mid-on
Just short of cover. Kishan reaches out and slaps this back of length delivery angled across. Miscues it but it doesn't carry to cover
Full on leg, clipped through midwicket
You gotta enjoy watching this man bat. Stands still and slaps away this length ball through extra cover.
Goes for the wide yorker, but it goes outside the wide line
Floated full on leg, clipped through square leg for a single
Slapped away! This is why you get rid of Abhishek Sharma when you have the chance! This is short and wide and Abhishek slaps it away disdainfully through cover
Kishan looks for the sweep but miscues it into the midwicket region
On a length on middle, tucked to the bowler's left for a single
Drives this full ball down to long-on
Dropped a bit short and Kishan greets the RR captain with a pull through square leg. Kishan continues to dominate
Full and wide, Abhishek leaves it, He keeps it inside the wide line. SRH end the powerplay on 89 for 1!
Now Abhishek takes on this short ball with a hopping jab through midwicket
Goes for a wide yorker, but it ends up a wide full toss. Kishan manages to drive it out to deep point
Back of length, on the pads, and Kishan just puts this away through backward square leg
Now another leg-side wide by Kishan
Brijesh slides down leg again and this time Kishan gets enough on it as he glances it fine of short fine leg to pick up four more
Drilled past the bowler by Ishan Kishan! This is full outside off and Kishan meets it with brute force and beats long-on running to his right
Brijesh Sharma starts off by sliding one down leg

Another sitter goes down and this time it's Ravindra Jadeja! Abhishek drives at this full toss outside off and gets it off the outside edge. It goes to Jadeja at backward point who had the simplest of catches, but somehow, he's made a meal of it! 14 drops in 64 overs of cricket today in the IPL, as per Sid Monga's calculations!
Abhishek properly on a roll now! Full toss on the stumps and Abhishek again makes room leg side and lifts it over cover
Oh my, Abhishek. Sensational! Backs away and Deshpande follows him with a short ball down leg. He waits on the slower ball and adjusts to dab it between backward point and short third

A lot happening there! Kishan tries to whip this full ball away and misses and is hit on the back knee. His bat comes out of his hands and he is hobbling across for the run. The fielder has a throw at the non-striker's end and it ends up hitting Kishan's right leg. Ouch and double-ouch
Full outside off, drilled back past the bowler and Kishan picks up a boundary off this overpitched slower ball
Full outside off, 138kph. Kishan hits a drive to mid-off
Slower bouncer again. Abhishek now skips out and slaps it away over point! Abhishek getting into the groove now

Short on off, slower bouncer. Abhishek backs away and tries to reach out for it. Abhishek reviews for wide not given. Abhishek was on his toes, and it did look like it went over his helmet on first viewing. DRS confirms it did go above head height. Now UltraEdge being checked for a possible nick. All clear. So the wide will be given

Flat-batted down the ground. Not the most convincing shot, but it gets the job done. Length ball angled across, and he makes room and slaps it straight of mid-on. This was a pace-off delivery from Burger
Back of length outside off, 142.5kph. He looks to pull and gets it off the bottom half
Abhishek will feel so much better after this one! Burger goes only slightly on the fuller side and Abhishek again skips out and hammers a flat inside-out shot over cover. Timed that to perfection

Hetmyer, what happened there? He lost the ball completely and almost got out of the way of the ball! Abhishek continues to ride his luck. 141kph length ball outside off, Abhishek looks to drive square and gets it off the outside half. Hetmyer first tries to go for the catch, ends up losing it and moves the other direction while covering his face
Slightly back of length outside off at 140kph. Abhishek flashes and misses
Overpitched, and Kishan hammers it over cover. 146kph half-volley and Kishan barely moves as he goes inside out over the infield
On a length around off and slanted across, Kishan looks for a cut but can't connect
Jaffa. On a length around off and it seams away to beat the outside edge. Kishan flummoxed by the bounce and pace there. Again over 140 clicks
Kishan continues to hammer away at Archer here. Width on offer with this length ball and Kishan punches it away through point, just beating the fielder. 140kph
Now he tries to slap away this length ball going across. Chops it onto the ground
Kishan does really well here. Length ball on middle, 143.6kph. Kishan waits on it and plays it late with an open face to steer it behind point for four
Another swing and a miss. Burger keeps his pace up. 144.3ks back of length delivery. Abhishek dances out and backs away, but can't get bat on it
Edged over the slip fielder! Abhishek flashes hard at this full ball outside off that's swinging away at 142.2kph. Gets a thick edge that's enough to get it over the cordon
Length ball seams in from outside off. Abhishek gets on top of it and parries it down
And now the bouncer beats everyone! Jagged in from outside off as well and Abhishek ducked under it. Jurel dives to his right but it rises too high for him
Abhishek skips out to this 143kph length ball and looks to hammer it down the ground. No connection at all
Length ball angled down leg, goes off his hips and beats Jurel's dive for four runs SRH will happily take
Length ball outside off, fended square on the off side

Absolute fire, and somehow it's gone for six! Kishan didn't have much of an idea about that one! Back of length ball rises sharper than Kishan expected and after initially shaping for a shot, Kishan is just trying to take evasive action, with his hands coming up to protect his head and the ball pings off the bat and flies over the keeper and all the way!

No first-ball wicket, but a first-over wicket nonetheless! Archer's bowled a superb first over here and he gets the rewards he deserves. This is a 140kph length ball around leg, cramping Head, who was backing away. Head gets squared up again and ends up with a thick edge and this time Jurel holds on. Five first-over wickets for Archer in IPL 2026!
Head responds in amazing fashion! This is a back of length delivery going across him and Head gets under it and lofts it over backward point. Almost scooped-square drive
Archer continues on that Test-match length and angles it across Head at 146.5kph. Head feels for it but gets nothing on it
Length ball, flashed wide. Head slaps at it but can't connect. Wide called
Length ball angled across again, Head lets it go

The catch-dropping flu has spread to the RR camp as well! Archer denied another first-ball wicket! 140kph length ball slanted across. Squares Head up and draws the outside edge. Jurel dives to his left, but he can't hold on!
